title: AgentNoiseBench: Benchmarking Robustness of Tool-Using LLM Agents Under Noisy Condition
reasoning: The paper focuses on evaluating the technical robustness and performance of LLM-based agents in the presence of environmental noise (categorized as user-side and tool-side noise).
